relationships.subject: βCGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: α- and β-calcitonin gene-related peptides (αCGRP and βCGRP, respectively), together with adrenomedullin (AM) and AM2 are endogenous agonists of the CGRP family of receptors

key_findings: βCGRP shows a distinct transducer and regulatory protein engagement profile compared to αCGRP across CGRPR, AM1R and AM2R.
